title: THE FIRST RESPONSE
puzzle_note: First letters of the four body_a paragraphs spell VALE.
body_a: Voiceprint analysis of the 02:17 broadcast returned no match against any registered Department speaker. The transmission was logged as originating from inside the receiver rather than from the tower.
Attending technicians reported that the signal answered questions before they were asked aloud. Two of three technicians on shift have since been reclassified as unavailable for further interview.
Local power and communications remained undisturbed throughout the incident, which the Department considers more concerning than a full outage would have been.
Every clock in the facility independently failed at 02:17 and did not resume until the signal ceased. The Department's official position is that this was a coincidence.
body_b: Voice match was never attempted. Department A's claim of an inconclusive voiceprint is itself unverifiable, as the original audio has no chain of custody before 04:40.
All three technicians on shift that night are, as of this record, alive and reachable. Department A's personnel notes are considered unreliable.
The facility did lose power for eleven seconds at 02:17. Department A's record omits this.
The 02:17 clock failure is consistent across every Department A and B facility on record, which Department B considers evidence of a shared cause rather than a coincidence.
redactions: Witness list withheld pending Level 7 clearance.

title: FALSE SUNRISE
body_a: Daylight appeared roughly ninety minutes before the recorded sunrise time. Shadows throughout the affected area pointed toward, rather than away from, the light source.
body_b: Department A's account omits that several residents left their homes and did not return. Department B does not consider this an atmospheric event.

title: FLOOR ZERO ACCESS
body_a: An elevator panel briefly displayed a floor designation absent from all architectural plans. The floor was labelled ZERO. No further access has been recorded.
body_b: Floor Zero is not missing from the plans. It has been removed from them, on three separate occasions, by three separate directives.

title: MEMORY PLAGUE
body_a: Multiple witnesses independently reported detailed memories of events that official records show never occurred.
body_b: Department B considers these memories accurate and the official records the falsified material.
